phaseEffects.effect: Characterized the blocking architecture before changing behavior.
phaseEffects.contendedOpen: more than 20 seconds with no response bytes

phaseEffects.effect: Removed writer initialization, migrations, and reserved-lock acquisition from snapshot GET.
Added query-only SQLite readers, data_version and inode invalidation, strong ETags, zero-body 304 responses, typed browser transport, and deadlines.
Removed synchronous process work from open/resume, used one Bridge read per open, single-flighted duplicate resumes, and deferred cosmetic paint.
Moved sidebar writes behind sanctioned catalogue commands and replaced raw transport failures with stable public envelopes plus private diagnostics.
Centralized warm caches, enrichment and recommendation disagreement logic, and staged projection internals while preserving the browser wire shape.
Separated schema, queries, and mutations; enforced mutation boundaries; and preserved three unrelated pre-existing circular dependencies.

Added snapshot stale-while-revalidate, bounded retry, exact serialized representation caching, hard subprocess termination, async bounded favicon reads, atomic SQLite replacement detection, and bounded LRU caches.
Evidence above the 150 ms gate justified a fixed, typed, rail-only cmux workspace-focus bridge restricted to local files and literal loopback origins.

fullRepository.flakyFailure: src/cli-auxiliary.test.ts timed out under the full-suite scheduler and passed 2/2 immediately in isolation

cmux.finalBotChecks: Cursor and Socket passed; Vercel and cubic were neutral or skipped; Codex was unavailable

transportDecision.sse: not justified: the quiet live soak produced 1760 zero-body 304 responses, p50 0.461 ms, p95 37.021 ms across mixed changed and unchanged polls, zero failures, and zero degraded snapshots
transportDecision.typedCmuxFocusBridge: shipped after optimized HTTP focus still exceeded the 150 ms evidence gate; 50 live native focuses completed at p95 6 ms with zero HTTP fallback

acceptedResiduals: The focus capability is intentionally narrow but is not rate-limited; a hostile service on a user-selected loopback URL could cause focus churn. The source scope, dispatch-time checks, and fixed verb keep exposure local and bounded.

The four MiB serialized-representation byte cap binds before the 16-entry cap at the current roughly 573 KiB body size, causing safe rebuilds under broad query-shape cycling rather than unbounded retention.
Catalogue retained-byte accounting costs about 4.1 ms on a live invalidation; cache hits and 304 responses do not pay it.
The final full repository suite retains four unrelated launcher fixture failures and one scheduler-only CLI auxiliary timeout that passed immediately in isolation.
